summary: The Victoria and Albert Museum (V&A) in London is launching a voluntary exit scheme for all staff. The news comes following a series of strikes organized by staff in two unions: Prospect and Public and Commercial Services (PCS). title: 330-Pound Dalí-Designed Bronze Book Cover Stolen from French Museum
summary: A bronze book jacket designed by famed Surrealist Salvador Dalí and weighing 330 pounds was swiped from a small private museum in Issoire, France, in an overnight theft this past weekend, Le Monde reports. Encrusted with precious stones, seashells, and cutlery, the cover is believed to have been taken between October 4 and October 5. […]

summary: The Phoenix Art Museum has received a $5 million gift from the philanthropist Dr. Sukumar Nagendran. The money will support acquisitions, scholarly research, and public programming, focused primarily on South Asian and Sri Lankan art.
